objective: Bring Orendil's Cure to Pelturas Whitemoon in Astranaar.

description: <name>, I have created a cure that I believe will help the afflicted child.  Take it to Astranaar and give it to the child's parent, Pelturas Whitemoon.
To reach Astranaar, follow the road south, then east.
progress: I must apologize, for I have no time to speak.  My child, Relara, is deathly ill!
completion: His skill with herbs and healing is great.  This cure gives me hope, when before I had little...
